name: drupal/daedalus
description: The Daedalus page builder: its UI, layout, inline editing, tempstore, JSON blueprints, AI assistant and styling ship as sub-modules of one project.

suggest.drupal/ai: Required by daedalus_ai, daedalus_ai_memory and daedalus_blueprint_ai for the AI assistant and agent tools.
suggest.drupal/ai_agents: Required by daedalus_ai and daedalus_ai_memory for the page-building agents.
suggest.drupal/ai_provider_anthropic: An LLM provider for the AI assistant; daedalus_ai_anthropic adds Claude-specific context.
suggest.drupal/gemini_provider: An LLM provider for the AI assistant; daedalus_ai_gemini adds Gemini-specific vocabulary.
suggest.drupal/key: Stores the LLM provider API keys.
suggest.league/commonmark: Renders the AI assistant's markdown replies in daedalus_ai's chat sidebar.
suggest.drush/drush: Provides the daedalus_blueprint and daedalus_edit Drush commands.
